what.text: This page follows refugees from South Sudan living in Sudan.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 634954 South Sudanese refugees in Sudan, 26.6% of all South Sudanese refugees.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of South Sudan from 2011 to 2021 and again in 2025, at war level in 2014.
The groups fighting the government include the SPLM/A - IO, which UCDP also lists in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Sudan rose from 115451 in 2014 to a peak of 852080 in 2018.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2025, after big changes in each year from 2014 to 2017.
Returns from Sudan to South Sudan were highest in 2023 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Sudan only; UNHCR records no South Sudanese asylum seekers there.
People displaced inside South Sudan are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Sudan they live.
